artifacts.summary: Nine-phase plan building orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh, migrating all 11 physical dispatch sites in skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md to fixed pointer prompts, writing the user-decision contract, sweeping agent contracts by routing table, and registering the .dispatch/ ephemeral class.

memory_candidates.content: When a refactor introduces a new ephemeral runtime-file class under specs/{NNN}_{SLUG}/, sequence the registration phase (orchestrator-runtime-files.md class table, .gitignore, git-staging-scope.md's ephemeral_excludes arrays -- note there are multiple copies -- and check-runtime-file-tracking.sh's EPHEMERAL_PROBES, which must probe a file INSIDE a directory class) strictly BEFORE the phase whose code first writes such a file. Registering afterward leaves a window in which the new file can be staged and committed by an intervening scoped commit. This also holds for the reverse direction: a per-task class that accumulates rather than being a singleton needs an explicit disposition decision at plan time, since no existing reaper recurses into per-task directories.
